verdict.rationale: Snyk CLI explicitly documents CI/CD pipeline usage (snyk-gh-3) alongside local/IDE runs, with concrete commands like `snyk test` and `snyk code test` that produce scriptable exit codes/reports (snyk-gh-2, snyk-gh-4, snyk-gh-5), and hands-on probes confirm the CLI installs and runs headlessly (snyk-probe-5, snyk-probe-7). missing for 10: no first-party CI-specific docs/config examples (e.g. GitHub Actions/Jenkins snippets) in the evidence pack, and the probe shows scans require authentication (no fully unauthenticated headless mode).
